name: Teaser
classification_notes: Classified as serif based on the OpenType feature set: Historical Forms, Oldstyle Figures, Standard Ligatures and Discretionary Ligatures are most strongly associated with historically-grounded serif text faces. Reymund Schröder's background in historical revivals at Forgotten Shapes supports this reading. Direct visual confirmation was not available as the site returns 403 errors.
summary: A single-style historically-grounded text face from Reymund Schröder's Leipzig indie studio.
description: Teaser is a solo release from Reymund Schröder, co-founder of Forgotten Shapes and designer behind NaN Hyena and NaN Druid. Its OpenType feature set — oldstyle figures, historical forms, standard and discretionary ligatures — points to a carefully detailed text typeface with historical grounding. As a single-style release, it reads as a contained typographic statement rather than a broad workhorse family.
foundry_blurb: Teaser Studio brings together several side projects by Reymund Schröder, a Leipzig-based type designer and co-founder of Forgotten Shapes, who also works with Production Type and NaN.
